interpretation: Tier 2 remains the lowest requirements tier to investigate, but no screened model alone closes all B6N7 dynamic interface/topology/support outputs. Buck-style reduced thin-sheet force/mode evolution is a conditional candidate, not selected.

families.transition_predicates: No physically defensible rift/interface/topology predicate without added law and thresholds.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: LOW_COMPUTATIONAL_COST; spatial support and interface frames still need authority; numerical dt refinement only addresses integration error.
adversarial_limitations: rigid relative displacement is not extension/accommodation
no transition coverage
does not predict an unsupplied synthetic event

families.transition_predicates: No generic interface regime, topology, or support predicate; post-rift cooling is not rift initiation/transition.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: LOW_TO_MODERATE_1D_COLUMN_COST; local columns lack lateral fault/junction dependencies.
families.mechanics: NO_FULL_MECHANICS_FOR_CLASSIC_RESPONSE; no emergence of mechanical transition
adversarial_limitations: extension is not model output
instantaneous/uniform assumptions restrict syn-rift time evolution
Earth basin inversion/calibration does not transfer by itself

families.transition_predicates: Model-specific physical outputs may define criteria only if separately justified; no universal ARCANA topology/support predicate identified.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: LOCAL_CROSS_SECTION_PLAUSIBLE; thermal diffusion and boundary dependencies define buffer; repeated solves more costly than column models.
families.mechanics: VARIES; purely kinematic-thermal versions omit dynamic localization, higher-fidelity versions require mechanics
adversarial_limitations: prescribed velocity/history is not emergent process
parameter identifiability
2D assumptions and lateral/junction behavior missing

process_outputs: model mode: widening vs continued localization
families.transition_predicates: Model defines a force-change-dependent widening/localization assumption; possible process/regime signal, not a general interface/topology transition predicate.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: REDUCED_THIN_SHEET/CROSS_SECTION_MORE_PLAUSIBLE_THAN_GLOBAL_3D; local independence and diffusion/force buffer must be proven; cost not benchmarked here.
families.mechanics: REDUCED_FORCE_BALANCE_AND_LITHOSPHERIC_STRENGTH_ARE_MECHANICAL_CONTENT; whether this meets ARCANA Tier-2 boundary requires adjudication
parameters_and_initialization: crust/mantle ductile strength and rate dependence
adversarial_limitations: widen/localize rule is model-specific
physical inputs absent/unadjudicated for synthetic ARCANA
not segment-resolved and no junction semantics
does not construct topology or govern support remapping
reduction may hide mechanically causal terms

families.transition_predicates: Potentially aligned to segment predicates, but no universal criterion; thresholds require source model and ARCANA authority.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: LOCAL_SUBNETWORK_MAY_BE_PLAUSIBLE; fault-stress interaction and junction closure can expand scope.
adversarial_limitations: prescribed fault histories fail predictive test
emergent faulting needs weakness/initialization and interaction law
segment/junction semantics and conservative topology coverage not automatic

families.transition_predicates: Can produce model-defined necking/failure/breakup diagnostics; event criteria and detector coverage remain model-specific, topology mutation remains separate.
families.locality_adaptive_cost: 2D/3D meshes and coupled nonlinear solves; regional HPC plausible, global high-resolution repeated long-run cost unquantified and high.
adversarial_limitations: high-dimensional state and parameters
rheology/weakness/thermal non-identifiability
Earth setups do not establish synthetic-world transfer
2D/3D boundary and junction mismatch
cost and replay burden

families.transition_predicates: No independent onset/localization/event predicate; history is supplied.
adversarial_limitations: prescribed fault geometry/displacement history
cannot forecast unprovided synthetic transition
no general topology predicate
